title: Nodes Response
description: Response of GET /__remote_everything/nodes: which nodes this device may reach. It is how a device that was granted one more node finds out about it without pairing again, and it is the one endpoint that is asked without naming a node.

ok.description: Always true: a device with no nodes at all is answered with an empty list, not with an error.

nodes.description: Every node this gateway serves that this device was granted, in the order the gateway recorded them. It says nothing about whether a node is reachable: liveness belongs to the node, and a client learns it by asking that node.

id.description: The node id a request names in the X-Remote-Everything-Node header.

name.description: What that node's operator calls it, which is what a client shows.
